key_insight: HISPO improves RLVR for long-form mathematical reasoning by applying importance-sampling correction at an intermediate, entropy-derived segment level instead of only token-level or whole-sequence level.
engineering_relevance: For practitioners fine-tuning language models on proof- or solution-style tasks, segment-level credit assignment offers a practical way to stabilize learning and better target the parts of a response that matter most.
method: Builds contiguous rollout segments using entropy-derived saliency.
Assigns soft weights to segments based on entropy.
Applies clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment granularity.
evidence_signal: The authors fine-tuned Qwen3-1.7B-Base and report results across six math benchmarks, with HISPO improving Pass@8 on all six and matching or exceeding the strongest baseline in Acc@8 on five.
watch_item: Entropy-based segmentation adds another heuristic layer, so performance may depend on segmentation quality and implementation details during rollout.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
